name: Paths to *
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND toLower(z.name) CONTAINS '*' RETURN p
description: Identify all paths to the * resource

name: Paths to IAM
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND toLower(z.name) = 'iam' RETURN p
description: Identify all paths to the IAM resource

name: Paths to Principal
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND (z:AWSUser OR z:AWSRole OR z:AWSGroup OR z:AWSPrincipal) AND NOT n.objectid = 'ARN:AWS:IAM::CHANGEME:USER/CHANGE' AND z.objectid = 'ARN:AWS:IAM::CHANGEME:USER/CHANGE' RETURN p
description: Identify all paths to a principal

name: Paths from Principal
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(res:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND n.objectid = 'ARN:AWS:IAM::CHANGEME:USER/CHANGE' OPTIONAL MATCH rp = (res:AWSResource)-[*..]->(r) RETURN p, rp
description: Identify all paths from a principal

name: All Administrators
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSPolicy)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND (toLower(z.name) CONTAINS 'administratoraccess' OR toLower(z.name) CONTAINS 'poweruseraccess') RETURN p

name: Roles Attached to Services
description: Identify all roles attached to a service

name: Paths to Inline Policies
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSPolicy)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND z.objectid CONTAINS ':INLINE/' RETURN p
description: Identify all paths to inline policies

name: All Foreign Principals
query: MATCH p = (r:AWSPrincipal)-[:awsAssumeRoleAllowed]->(z)-[*..]->(res:AWSResource) WHERE NOT toLower(z.name) CONTAINS 'aws' RETURN p

name: Paths to SecretsManager
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND toLower(z.name) = 'secretsmanager' RETURN p

name: Paths to Resource with Edge Restriction
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND toLower(z.name) = 'lambda' WITH p WHERE any(r IN relationships(p) WHERE type(r) = 'lambdaAllAccess') RETURN p
description: Identify all paths to a resource with specific edges

name: Policies with Modify Permissions
query: MATCH p = (n:AWSPolicy)-[r]->(z:AWSResource) WHERE toLower(type(r)) CONTAINS 'create' OR toLower(type(r)) CONTAINS 'put' OR toLower(type(r)) CONTAINS 'update' OR toLower(type(r)) CONTAINS 'add' OPTIONAL MATCH rp = allShortestPaths((v)-[*..]->(n:AWSPolicy)) WHERE (v:AWSUser OR v:AWSRole OR v:AWSGroup OR v:AWSPrincipal) RETURN p,rp
description: Identify all paths with edges that allow you to modify resources

name: Principals with Wildcard Conditions
query: MATCH p = (n:AWSPrincipal)-[q:awsAssumeRoleAllowed]->(z:AWSRole) WHERE q.condition CONTAINS '*' RETURN p
description: Identify all principals with wildcard conditions

name: Resource Relationships Excluding AWS
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) and NOT toLower(n.name) CONTAINS 'aws' RETURN p

name: Access to S3 Bucket
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND (z:AWSResource) AND z.objectid = 'ARN:AWS:S3:::CHANGE' RETURN p
description: Identify all paths to an S3 bucket
